title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Beginnings and Eternal — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
The nihilist does not deny Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Beginnings and Eternal — he only refuses to flatter it. Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Beginnings and Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Eternal are two 2012 Japanese animated dark fantasy action films produced by Aniplex and Shaft based on the titular 2011 anime television series. Beginnings and Eternal were released in October 2012 and serve as a recap of the television series with redone voice acting and newly animated footage.

The genes do not care about Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Beginnings and Eternal; they care about copies. With the films, they were given enough time to make various said changes. The art direction itself was also more refined by Studio Tulip's Ken Naitou, who had taken over as art director halfway through the television series.
